description: Do not copy this file verbatim. Generate current-path snippets with scripts/generate-mcp-config.py.
notes: Run start.cmd before using the OpenClaw HTTP configuration.
Codex launches src/server.py directly over stdio with KR_MCP_TRANSPORT=stdio; it does not depend on a shared HTTP service or wrapper host.
Other stdio configs use the same direct src/server.py contract and do not require the HTTP server to be pre-started.
Generated snippets use the current checkout path and avoid hard-coded developer paths.
